why: The owner decided 3.0 under the same name. The gate changes on purpose, before the first breaking commit, and is the only thing standing between master and an accidental publish: before GA it refuses every computed version except the owner-flagged first 3.0.0.
what: scripts/release.sh version_gate and scripts/release.test.ts only. One PR to master. .releaserc.json stays `branches: ["master"]`: no prerelease config, no v2 line, no dist-tag selection.
contract: docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 3.1 (table, constants), 4.3. Mechanism for 3.0.0, read from the installed preset (conventional-changelog-angular 8.3.0, the default for @semantic-release/commit-analyzer 13.0.1): only the note keyword `BREAKING CHANGE` yields `breaking: true` -> major; `feat!:` does not parse and computes no release. So the single designated commit is the `feat:` plus `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer of v3-rel-7-skeleton; from that merge on every dry run computes major from the last tag (v2.29.0) = 3.0.0. No releaseRules or .releaserc.json change. Insufficient contract: factory signal, reversible default, PR body says so.
exemplar: The existing version_gate cases in scripts/release.test.ts.
change: readonly CURRENT_MAJOR=3. version_gate <bump> <version> <ga_tag_exists> <ga_flag>; ga_tag_exists is 1 when `git ls-remote --tags origin v3.0.0` prints a ref, else 0; ga_flag is 1 only when the owner sets GA=1 in the environment. Master-only: no LINE, no branch argument. Table: no v3.0.0 tag: accept only version 3.0.0 with bump major and ga_flag=1; refuse everything else, including any 2.x, any prerelease and 3.0.0 without the flag (the reason names GA=1 and that the first publish is the owner's go). v3.0.0 tag exists: accept ^3\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ not major and not 3.0.0; refuse any major until CURRENT_MAJOR changes, naming MAINTAINING.md section 'Major lines'. Unparsed bump or empty version fails closed. Rewrite the table-driven tests. Ships with: version_gate table as the rule, no skill snippet.
commits: Non-package `ci:` commits, one PR to master. No attribution.
proof: bun test scripts/release.test.ts. Reviewed deep. A post-merge dry run is an orchestrator check, not lead acceptance.
acceptance: bun test scripts/release.test.ts passes with a case per row of migration-release 3.1: pre-GA 3.0.0 major with ga_flag=1 accepted; pre-GA 3.0.0 without the flag, 2.29.1, 2.30.0 and any prerelease refused; post-GA 3.1.0 and 3.0.1 accepted, 3.0.0 and any major refused; unparsed bump and empty version refused.
grep -c 'CURRENT_MAJOR=3' scripts/release.sh prints 1; grep -rn 'only stable 2.x\|PREVIOUS_MAJOR\|dist_tag_for\|LINE=' scripts/release.sh returns nothing.
A test shows ga_tag_exists is 1 for a stubbed git ls-remote that prints a v3.0.0 ref and 0 for empty output.
git diff --name-only origin/master...HEAD lists only scripts/release.sh and scripts/release.test.ts.
out_of_scope: Doctrine prose (rel-5, rel-6), commitlint rules (rel-8), the GA runbook.
post_merge: Orchestrator, on a clean master after v3-rel-7-skeleton merged: `make release-dry` computes 3.0.0 and the gate refuses it without GA=1. Not lead acceptance (release.sh preflight needs a clean master).
